title: A Study of CAR-T Cells in Subjects With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
off: A Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of CAR-T Cells in Subjects With Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE)
sponsor: Union Hospital, Tongji Medical College, Huazhong University of Science and Technology
summary: The purpose of this study is to assess the safety and efficacy of CAR-T cell therapy in Subjects with SLE.
